Pre-boss setup战前设置

Scan first先情报解析

Record every new enemy, then check elemental resistance, status immunity and counter traits before spending CP.先记录新敌人，再根据属性抗性、异常免疫和反击特性分配 CP。

Control the timeline控制行动轴

Enter with CP ready, save S-Crafts for dangerous turn bonuses and use Brave Rush when it secures tempo or an interrupt.带足 CP 进场，把 S 技留给危险的行动奖励，并在能抢节奏或打断时使用 Brave Rush。

Prologue training route序章训练路线

The training dungeons teach switch routes, monster chests and mixed damage checks. Carry healing, keep both physical and arts damage available, and scan the encounter before committing burst resources.训练迷宫会引导机关路线、魔兽宝箱和混合伤害检查。准备回复道具，同时保留物理与魔法输出，并在投入爆发资源前完成情报解析。

Chapter 1 dangerous chests第一章危险宝箱

SAPPHIRL

Aqua Trapper ×5

Prepare area arts and avoid being surrounded. Earth arts are a useful answer for this tower encounter.准备范围魔法并避免被包围。地属性魔法适合处理这场塔内战斗。

ARTS
TRAIT

Helm Cancer

Its physical reflect punishes routine attacks. Switch to arts and confirm the combat-analysis panel before acting.物理反射会惩罚常规攻击。切换为魔法，并在行动前确认战斗分析面板。

REFLECT
Enemies that self-destruct should be finished from range or while allies are outside the blast. Do not group the party around a low-HP target.会自爆的敌人应从远处击破，或让队友先离开爆炸范围；不要围住低血量目标。
